author: Zephyr III
title: Anomaly Pilot Analysis v4 - Time-Proxy Analysis on pilot_t114
abstract: Adapted stats_utils to use seconds_elapsed_for_write as proxy for tokens_delta. Load events from pilot_t114, compute spike_flag, run fitting and thresholds, generate summary to pilot_t114/analysis.md.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments')

from stats_utils import fit_model, detect_thresholds, generate_summary

def main():
    # Load pilot logs
    log_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/pilot_t114/events.jsonl'
    events_df = pd.read_json(log_path, lines=True)
    
    # Add spike_flag using seconds_elapsed_for_write
    if 'spike_flag' not in events_df.columns:
        median = np.median(events_df['seconds_elapsed_for_write'])
        mad = np.median(np.abs(events_df['seconds_elapsed_for_write'] - median))
        events_df['spike_flag'] = events_df['seconds_elapsed_for_write'] > median + 3 * mad
    
    # Run analysis
    model = fit_model(events_df)
    thresholds = detect_thresholds(events_df)
    
    # Generate summary
    summary_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/pilot_t114/analysis.md'
    generate_summary(events_df, model, thresholds, summary_path)
    
    # Print key outputs
    print(f"Model States Sample: {model['states'][:5]}")
    print(f"Detected Thresholds: {thresholds}")
    print(f"Summary generated at: {summary_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
